text:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a weird p95 jump for the /v1/generate endpoint on the canary rollout this morning. p50 unchanged, p99 barely moves, sample counts look similar. anyone seen this? :thinking:
mina: hmm can you paste the console slice? is it by endpoint or by route?
sam: canary weight changed at 09:12UTC? deploy-bot says rollout 0.2 -> 0.5 then back to 0.3 earlier. maybe traffic mix shifted.
alex: screenshot: (console) endpoint=/v1/generate scope=canary p50=85ms p95=420ms p99=1200ms samples=1.8k
jordan: are we including prefix/KV cache hits in server_time or only service processing? that often nukes p95 when cache miss tail shows up.
mina: our telemetry tag set should include "sample_origin": ["ingress","kvcache_hit","backend"]. UI shows only route-level bodies sometimes which collapses origin. can we confirm query?
ben: quick check — ran the console query with include_retries=false and origin breakdown. interestingly, the p95 for backend-only is 380ms, but when we include kvcache_miss events p95 jumps to 420ms. so cache-miss tail is the delta.
alex: so dashboard p95 is a blended view (we were expecting backend-only). should call this out in legend. ui-ux-beth: agreed — the legend should indicate whether p95 is derived from merged origins or a single origin. we have room for a small badge: "sources: merged" vs "source: backend".
sam: other confounder: routing fallback to smaller model variant triggers extra latency ~200ms for a subset of requests. canary had a couple fallback spikes around 09:15. deploy-bot: "Fallback triggered on node g3-12 at 09:14:33 — capacity limit"
mina: UI proposal: make the sample_origin badge clickable to toggle provenance breakdown; default to merged but show p50/p95/p99 per origin on hover. also surface sample counts per origin.
jordan: also request we document semantics: are our percentiles computed on raw token-level latency or request-level end-to-end? different teams expect different things.
ben: FYI query I ran: ```sql
SELECT origin, percentile(50, latency_ms) p50, percentile(95, latency_ms) p95, count(*) samples
FROM latency_events
WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND time >= '2026-03-23T09:00:00Z' AND rollout='canary'
GROUP BY origin;
```
alex: actionable items: 1) eng-platform to add legend/badge explaining sample provenance (UI), 2) telemetry to ensure origin tag is present and non-null (eng-runtime), 3) docs to clarify percentile semantics (docsite). who's owning UI badge? @ui-ux-beth
ui-ux-beth: I'll mock up a badge and hover layout, pushing a brief prototype to figma by EOD. probably add a small "i" tooltip: "Percentiles computed on request end-to-end, merged across origins by default."
sam: runtime will add an explicit "origin" field to the route telemetry if missing and backfill for recent 48h where possible. ETA: 2 days.
mina: also suggestion: add a canary-specific anomaly alert that breaks out p95 by origin so we don't get surprised by cache-miss tails. low-priority but useful.
alex: perfect. thanks all. tagging here: @ben for the example queries, @sam for telemetry changes, @ui-ux-beth for the badge mock, @jordan for docs wording. we'll reconvene if the prototype surfaces other issues. :thumbsup:
